A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
aCGH is an important tool for prenatal genetic diagnosis.
aneuploidy of chromosome 13q and chromosome 8p can be detected by aCGH and can be associated with increased NT.

The main takeaway from our work is that
aCGH is a powerful tool in the detection of unbalanced translocations and in prenatal diagnosis of anencephaly associated with increased NT.
